rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (10 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Com_Lag_(2plus2isfive), https://www.discogs.com/release/241493-Radiohead-Com-Lag-2plus2isfive. Sixth EP (Mar 24, 2004, Toshiba-EMI Japan; also released in Australia). Collects Hail to the Thief B-sides plus remixes by Cristian Vogel and Four Tet. The CD also contains a live video of '2 + 2 = 5' (Belfort Festival) as a CD-Extra. Official stylizations 'Remyxomatosis' and 'Skttrbrain' preserved.
